skill_tiers.method: sum of the `description:` field bytes across .opencode/skills/*/SKILL.md; frontend-visible subset = names matching react|next|frontend|ui|css|tailwind|design|a11y
skill_tiers.note: This measures the skill-DESCRIPTION slice only. The 81% claim covers the whole input (system prompt + context + histories); that share is not measured here.

symphony_transport.method: legacyPayloadToSignature + signatureToLegacyPrompt on a real hop brief, repeated 1x/4x/10x
symphony_transport.finding: The 70-90% reduction is REAL for large payloads (>= ~4.7KB: 71-83%) and INVERTED for short briefs (< ~1KB: -39% to -159%). A size threshold must accompany the claim.
